The reverse look-back street view shows the same arrangement on this side of the double yellow line: one travel lane, then a solid white edge line, then cars parked at the kerb, then the sidewalk with café seating. r1 is therefore supported as a travel facility, but it covers one motor-vehicle lane plus a parking strip; only about 3.5 m of its 5.5 m width is travel lane. Most of it lies in building shadow.
